title: Find XOR-Beauty of Array
description: Given a 0-indexed integer array `nums` of length `n`, the effective value of any ordered index triplet `(i, j, k)` with `0 <= i, j, k < n` is defined as `((nums[i] | nums[j]) & nums[k])`. The XOR-beauty of `nums` is the bitwise XOR of the effective values of all `n^3` ordered triplets `(i, j, k)`. Return the XOR-beauty of `nums`.
hints: Notice symmetry in `(i, j)`: for any `i != j`, the triplets `(i, j, k)` and `(j, i, k)` produce the exact same effective value and cancel each other out under XOR, leaving only triplets with `i == j`.

When `i == j`, the expression simplifies to `nums[i] & nums[k]`, where again `i != k` pairs cancel by symmetry, leaving only `i == j == k` and reducing the entire answer to the XOR of all elements of `nums`.

examples.explanation: Evaluating all 8 triplets for [1, 4] and XORing them yields 1 ^ 4 = 5.
Symmetric off-diagonal triplets cancel out, leaving the XOR of all elements which equals 34.
